requirement: Lifecycle ordering and reached locations remain correct

inputs.name: default
inputs.call: fresh process: godot --headless --path . --script driver.gd (add_child, one process_frame, remove_child)

notes: The coverage schema's hit obligations can only assert that each callback body ran at least once (line 6, 9, 12 all true) -- they cannot express the ORDER in which they ran, which is the actual requirement here ('lifecycle ordering'). A log side-channel (same technique as F013/F030) carries that ground truth instead: enter_tree fires when add_child() attaches the node to the live tree, ready fires once at the end of the frame in which the node entered the tree (confirmed empirically: NOT synchronously with add_child -- it requires awaiting a process_frame first), and exit_tree fires synchronously when remove_child() detaches the node. Confirmed on the pinned Godot 4.7.1 engine via this fixture's own driver.gd.
